decisions.reason: As a close-to-core, relatively low-cost webshop plugin, it likely still earns its place unless sustained weak demand has become clear, so management would keep it for now.
The ERP interface plugin is strategically complementary to broader multichannel shop support and therefore still has strong option and cross-selling value despite ongoing maintenance effort.

After several years, uncertainty about this overlapping price-comparison tracking plugin should be largely resolved, and real-options logic favors pruning a redundant variant to free resources for stronger offers.

Given the portfolio overlap in price-comparison tracking and the time already elapsed since launch, management would likely discontinue this duplicate option and reallocate effort to the core business and new development.
